granite-switch-4.1-30b.author: IBM Granite (ibm-granite on Hugging Face)
granite-switch-4.1-30b.disclosure: Measured on the 27 Oct 2026 draw and shown unranked until that draw is equated to the reference scale. The composed decision checkpoint and selected recipe differ from the author Decision Index system-prompt recipe; reported Decision Index numbers are not transferred here. The read-only plugin was registered with a first-party distribution marker without running author build scripts. Composer/tutorial subtrees were excluded; audio limit zero and skip-mm-profiling prevented optional ASR loading. The local shim and vLLM backend communicated over loopback inside a read-only container with no external network, empty credentials, offline flags, read-only mounts and restricted capabilities. A local memory observer read peak CUDA allocator memory without changing tensors or probabilities; the shim could not proxy its dev-RPC route. Source and tokenizer hashes were verified before protected staging. Upstream wheels were hash-locked; Debian libgomp1 12.2.0-14+deb12u1 and libnuma1 2.0.16-1 were recorded. Source checks and isolation are not a full audit of upstream code/custom kernels, a contamination audit, or a minimum-hardware guarantee. Training data and overlap with evaluation data were not independently inspected. The model card and Granite Switch source declare Apache-2.0; the Hugging Face checkpoint contains no standalone LICENSE file. Exact provider deletion of the VM and OS volume and private staging shreds were verified. No scored retry, response repair, permutation averaging or replacement was used. Replay is record-only: 7 of 50 bit-identical, ONE argmax flip, maximum absolute probability difference 0.031222338329561394; this differs from the separately measured 8B row. Whole states and ordered options were preserved, with no truncation/refusal. Native 818,484 input and 1,500 output tokens include all full-prompt chunks. Five requests above ten seconds count as wrong answers. The measured base remains ibm-granite/granite-4.1-30b; the price uses the explicitly labelled granite-4.2-30b sibling estimate, with no invented cross-family throughput, observed-loop extrapolation or pod-bill substitution.
granite-switch-4.1-30b.endpoint_condition: Measured 31 October 2026 on one evaluator-operated Verda RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPU, nominal 96 GB, in FIN-03, Finland (EU), PAYG non-spot. Text and the decision adapter only; Guardian and speech-to-text were not evaluated. The composed checkpoint ibm-granite/granite-switch-4.1-30b@eb206725d03c0f1c409ce3aa512afe325fdf8731 identifies its decision adapter as revision 4.1.1 and ran with generative-computing/granite-switch@43ccd291a176507ae4ed5af293f8f2d947c0d451. No base-plus-adapter recomposition or direct PEFT substitute. Stock vLLM 0.30.0, Torch 2.13.0+cu130, CUDA 13.0, Transformers 5.17.0, tokenizers 0.23.3, Triton 3.7.1, BF16, max-num-seqs=1, chunked prefill=2048 and gpu-memory-utilization=0.90. TRITON_ATTN was selected explicitly; FlashInfer sampling, all-reduce and autotune were disabled to avoid an unavailable nvcc path. Backend selection can change roundoff and performance; no cross-backend numerical equivalence is claimed. The author Decision Index recipe includes a fixed system prompt; this measurement used no system prompt, followed by a State: user turn and a DECISION user turn containing the whole question, ordered option descriptions and an instruction to reply with one option label. The local wire shim reads raw first-generated-position label logprobs, not the sampled answer token. Explicit label reads use chunks of at most 128 IDs over the identical full prompt and join them using one stable global softmax. Every actual full-prompt and generated label-read token from every chunk is billed in native usage. Native output is one generated token per actual call, not the tokenless convention. All 1,500 requests returned HTTP 200: 818,484 native input and 1,500 output tokens, zero usage mismatches and zero native-behavior deviations. Semantic context is 131,072 tokens; no prompt truncation or native refusal occurred. Replay variability: 7 of 50 repeated requests were bit-identical, with ONE argmax flip and maximum absolute probability difference 0.031222338329561394. Exact probability reproducibility is not established. Repeats were recorded only; no scored answer was averaged, repaired, replaced or retried. The public same-engine label re-extraction check was fixed before measurement at a 5e-2 absolute ceiling with exact label sets, own-winner consistency and a near-tie allowance. This passed; it is not a cross-backend equivalence test. Median measured latency was 0.07952452649999486 seconds and maximum 21.930013085999917 seconds; five decisions exceeded ten seconds and count as wrong answers under the unchanged ten-second rule. The price uses the labelled sibling estimate because Granite is outside the six calibrated Gemma/Qwen throughput classes; no GPU-time component is available.
